actual_manual_comparison: Actually compared native 65x67 source, nearest4 pixels, complete unchanged 1235x1274 raw output, fitted pair and white/cyan sheets. Real photograph rim, warm dark opaque-looking photographic backing, right cream note with original tiny indistinct markings, note tilt and cheek/chest occlusion remain. Tan peaked cap/black visor and band, small source gold crest/fastener, close-cropped grey temple hair, eyebrow hair, clean closed mascot mouth, red shoulder trim and tan closed collar are retained. Tiny original collar and cap motifs cannot be resolved to every historical point; acceptance covers their source-visible footprint/colour rather than claiming identification of a precise named device. No floppy hair tufts, moustache, beard, exposed ears, extra hanging medal on the paper, text or hardware. Compact chin meets the closed collar without long neck, cream bib or floating edges. Whole alpha 0..255 provides genuine exterior transparency; solid samples 252..254 and actual white/cyan comparison show no hollow photograph, garment holes or lost note. Approved art/collar at source resolution, not live-game-tested.
